node_notes.i2cport: This STM32 HAL adapter serializes shared I2C transactions and configures I2C1 pins. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c binds SCL to PB8 and SDA to PB9 and performs HAL transfers.
node_notes.dhtport: This adapter drives and samples the DHT22 single-wire line and decodes its captured frame. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_dht22.c uses PB4 and TIM3 for edge timing.
node_notes.app: The application coordinates sensor polling, alert updates, display refresh, and telemetry from app_start. Its service calls and loop are implemented in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.bus: I2C1 is shared by the motion sensor and OLED. firmware/configs/app_config.h assigns SCL to PB8 and SDA to PB9, and the STM32 adapter performs transfers on those pins.
node_notes.mpuhw: The MPU6050 is the motion sensor addressed at 0x68. firmware/configs/app_config.h selects that address and the motion adapter accesses its registers over I2C1.
node_notes.dht: The DHT22 returns climate data over its bidirectional single-wire connection. firmware/configs/app_config.h assigns that data line to PB4.
node_notes.uartout: This adapter provides UART writes used for direct telemetry and bridged logging. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c configures USART2 and transmits through HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.uart: USART2 carries logs and telemetry through the board's ST-LINK Virtual COM Port. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c configures PA2 as TX and PA3 as RX at the configured 115200 baud.
node_notes.timer: TIM3 provides the free-running microsecond counter used to time DHT22 edges. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_dht22.c initializes and starts the timer.
node_notes.oledport: This adapter packages SH1106 command or data bytes for the shared I2C bus. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_oled.c implements oled_port_write using i2c_bus_write.
node_notes.climate: The climate service schedules DHT22 acquisition and returns readings to the application. The app polls it through climate_service_poll in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.logsvc: The logging API receives application diagnostics and forwards them to its platform writer. The app uses LOGI and LOGE, and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_logger.c bridges those writes to USART2.
node_notes.ledport: This platform adapter initializes and writes the board indicator. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_indicator.c drives LD4 on PA5 with HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.led: LD4 is the board indicator driven by the firmware. firmware/configs/app_config.h and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_indicator.c bind its output to PA5.
node_notes.motionport: This STM32 adapter connects the motion driver to the shared I2C bus. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_motion.c supplies register callbacks for MPU6050 access.
node_notes.oled: The OLED service refreshes the dashboard from a snapshot of climate and motion state. firmware/app/app.c calls oled_service_refresh, while the SH1106 path sends output over the shared I2C bus.
node_notes.logger: This platform bridge forwards the logger API to the UART2 platform writer. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_logger.c implements logger_platform_write.
node_notes.motion: The motion service supplies sampled motion data and pending events to the application. The application invokes motion_service_poll and retries initialization when motion is unavailable.
node_notes.mpu: The portable driver initializes the MPU6050 and decodes motion register bursts. firmware/drivers/mpu6050/mpu6050.c uses the adapter callbacks for register access.
node_notes.shdriver: The SH1106 driver initializes the display, renders text, and flushes framebuffer chunks. firmware/drivers/sh1106/sh1106.c delegates transfers through oled_port_write.
node_notes.alert: The alert policy converts motion events and elapsed time into an active event and LED state. firmware/modules/alert_indicator.c implements alert_indicator_update, which the application calls while polling services.
node_notes.oledhw: The SH1106 display receives commands and framebuffer data at address 0x3C. firmware/configs/app_config.h defines the OLED address and the SH1106 adapter writes through I2C1.

node_notes.motionpoll: When motion is ready, the app polls for a sample, reports it, and acknowledges pending events. firmware/app/app.c handles the motion service result and event acknowledgement.
node_notes.delay: The loop waits for the configured idle delay before starting another pass. firmware/configs/app_config.h sets APP_MOTION_IDLE_DELAY_MS to 1.
node_notes.poll: Each iteration polls generated telemetry and begins the application service work. firmware/app/app.c contains the bare-metal for loop and calls app_poll_services.
node_notes.retry: When retry is due, the app attempts motion initialization again. firmware/app/app.c invokes app_try_initialize_motion from app_poll_services.
node_notes.enter: This step starts the application and provides the telemetry component with the UART handle. firmware/app/app.c calls firmgen_telemetry_start from app_start.
node_notes.oledpoll: The app makes a snapshot from the latest service readings and asks the OLED service to refresh it. firmware/app/app.c implements this in app_poll_oled.
node_notes.alertstep: The app updates alert state and writes the indicator only when its logical output changes. firmware/app/app.c calls alert_indicator_update and indicator_port_set.
node_notes.retrydue: This branch checks whether the configured motion retry interval has elapsed while the service is unavailable. firmware/app/app.c compares the current time against app_last_motion_retry_ms.
node_notes.setupbus: The application initializes the shared I2C bus and scans for responding devices before continuing. firmware/app/app.c calls i2c_bus_init and i2c_bus_scan during startup.
node_notes.setupservices: This step initializes climate acquisition and the indicator, then resets alert and OLED state. firmware/app/app.c performs these setup calls in app_start.
node_notes.ready: This branch selects normal motion polling only when initialization has succeeded. firmware/app/app.c checks app_motion_ready in app_poll_services.
node_notes.setupmotion: The application attempts to configure the motion service and records whether it is ready. firmware/app/app.c implements the attempt in app_try_initialize_motion.
node_notes.climatepoll: The application polls climate acquisition and reports valid readings, or records an acquisition failure. firmware/app/app.c calls climate_service_poll and app_report_climate in app_poll_services.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant App as app_start runtime
  participant I2C as I2C1 bus adapter
  participant Climate as Climate service and DHT22 PB4
  participant Motion as Motion service and MPU6050 0x68
  participant Display as OLED service and SH1106 0x3C
  participant LED as LD4 PA5
  participant Log as UART logger
  participant UART as USART2

  App->>UART: firmgen_telemetry_start with UART handle
  App->>I2C: i2c_bus_init then i2c_bus_scan
  App->>Climate: climate_service_init
  App->>LED: indicator_port_init
  App->>App: Initialize alert and OLED service state
  App->>Motion: Attempt motion_service_init
  App->>Log: Log startup and initialization results
  Log->>UART: Transmit logs through USART2

  loop Bare-metal application loop with 1 ms idle delay
    App->>App: firmgen_telemetry_poll
    alt Motion service ready
      App->>Motion: motion_service_poll
      Motion->>I2C: Read MPU6050 acceleration registers
      I2C-->>Motion: Register sample or bus status
      Motion-->>App: Reading, status, or pending event
    else Motion not ready and retry interval elapsed
      App->>Motion: Retry motion_service_init
      Motion->>I2C: Configure and verify MPU6050 registers
      I2C-->>Motion: Initialization result
      Motion-->>App: Ready or failure status
    else Motion not ready and retry not due
      App->>App: Continue without motion acquisition
    end
    App->>App: Update alert policy
    opt LED logical state changed
      App->>LED: indicator_port_set
      LED->>LED: Write LD4 output on PA5
    end
    App->>Climate: climate_service_poll
    opt Climate sample due
      Climate->>Climate: Capture DHT22 frame on PB4 using TIM3
      Climate-->>App: Reading or acquisition status
      App->>Log: Report climate result or failure
      Log->>UART: Transmit log through USART2
    end
    App->>Display: oled_service_refresh with current snapshot
    Display->>I2C: Send SH1106 command or data chunk
    I2C-->>Display: Transfer status
    App->>UART: Write due motion and climate telemetry
  end
